description:
Comprehensive Hardware Analysis, Monitoring and Reporting for Windows and DOS.


- Added reporting of monitored process name to RTSS sensor title.
- Added workaround for NVML crash during GPU driver update.
- Fixed NZXT Kraken Elite V2 support.
- Fixed reporting of negative temperatures for NVIDIA GPU memory chips.
- Added ability to show multiple values on one line in OSD.
- Fixed reporting of PCH power on Intel Panther Lake and later.
- Added reporting of Fan Duty for Thermal Grizzly WireView Pro II.
- Added options to insert notes into json sensor log.
- Improved Nova Lake QS support and fixed SA VID reporting.
- Enhanced sensor monitoring on ASUS X870 MAX series.
- Fixed a bug in moving sensor item down in the list.
- Added reporting of NVMe power states supported.
- Added reporting of Dolby Vision Support.
- Fixed custom user sensor in HKLM path.
- Fixed access to PCIe extended space on legacy systems (XP).
